E0137

A range type's declared bounds are empty/reversed (`lo > hi`) (D-RANGETYPE1)

What

A range type's declared bounds are empty/reversed (`lo > hi`) (D-RANGETYPE1)

Why

The registered parse rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0137

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0137: tests/ui/range_type_empty_range.stderr.

Error [E0137]: this range is empty — 10 is after 0
  --> tests/ui/range_type_empty_range.jet:1:26
    |
  1 | Severity :: distinct Int(10..0);
    |                          ^^^^^
 Why: a range's low bound must not be greater than its high bound
 Fix: write `0..10` (swap the bounds), or fix the values
